message: No detected untrusted source handling: All data is received via direct HTTP file uploads; no remote source fetching (URL, S3, HuggingFace, etc.) is present, so no integrity verification or source authentication is implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code only drops object-typed columns and normalizes column names; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via TraindedModelStorage.get_trained_model_object() and saves uploaded .joblib files directly without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check.
No detected label distribution validation: No class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection are performed before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress-test logic is present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split is performed, there is no signed or hashed evaluation data, no truly isolated held-out set enforced by policy, and no protection against a caller passing already-seen data; the split is a basic random split with no integrity guarantees.

No detected input sanitization: The only validation applied is a file extension check via is_allowed_file(); there are no input shape, dtype, range, or schema checks on the CSV data before it is passed to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: The __predict method returns raw predictions and probabilities directly with no NaN guards, probability range checks, or threshold validation before the result is returned.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (RandomForest, XGBoost, LogisticRegression, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and are not present.
